name: protendai/nativephp-billing
description: Google Play Billing for NativePHP Mobile v4: subscriptions (base plans, free trials, intro offers, upgrades) and one-time products (consumable and non-consumable), with purchase tokens for server-side verification. Android only for now; iOS (StoreKit 2) is on the roadmap.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Products
bridge_functions.description: Load subscription or one-time products with prices, base plans and offers. Async: ProductsLoaded.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Purchase
bridge_functions.description: Open Google Play's purchase sheet for a subscription base plan/offer or a one-time product. Async: PurchaseUpdated.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Restore
bridge_functions.description: List what the Google account owns now (active subscriptions, unconsumed one-time products). Async: PurchasesRestored.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Acknowledge
bridge_functions.description: Acknowledge a purchase on the device (apps without a server). Async: PurchaseAcknowledged.

bridge_functions.name: ProtendaiBilling.Consume
bridge_functions.description: Consume a one-time purchase so it can be bought again. Async: PurchaseConsumed.
